issue: The earlier behavioral analysis aligned raw rows to reordered nominal stimulus/category labels rather than to the randomized paired-block presentation order.
resolution: Stimulus and category labels were reconstructed from participant-specific published sequences and the paired three-trial block design. Context-dependent analyses use a separately audited subset with context recovered from EDF annotations.
personalization_result: The fixed incremental-personalization support rule was not satisfied for valence or liking.
analysis_not_included: The context-by-category saturated nominal comparator is not used for any current conclusion.
